# spo_site_script (Resource)

Manages a SharePoint site script (Add/Get/Set/Remove-SPOSiteScript, CSOM) — a JSON document consumed by site designs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "spo_site_script" "brand" {
  title       = "Apply brand theme"
  description = "Applies the corporate theme to new sites."
  content = jsonencode({
    "$schema" = "schema.json"
    actions   = [{ verb = "applyTheme", themeName = "Contoso" }]
    bindata   = {}
    version   = 1
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) The site script JSON (the actions document).
- `title` (String) The site script display name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The site script description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `identity` (String) Identity used to target the object in cmdlets.
